words: On Sun 1 Nov, 4 of 4 areas were away from this person's usual (1.5 or more): sleep, body clock, activity and heart. The watch index, the average of the 4 areas with data, was 2.7 of 4. The check-in score was 1.6 of 4, and the two together 2.2. 0 is usual for them, 4 is far from usual.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.words: Sleep: 2.0 of 4, away from usual (1.5 or more). It is the larger of sleep length (1.7) and sleep irregularity (2.0).

circadian.label: Body clock
circadian.words: Body clock: 2.7 of 4, away from usual (1.5 or more). It is how far the middle of sleep moved, here later than usual.

activity.label: Activity
activity.words: Activity: 3.0 of 4, away from usual (1.5 or more). It is how far steps fell below usual.

cardiac.label: Heart
cardiac.words: Heart: 3.2 of 4, away from usual (1.5 or more). It is the larger of resting heart rate (3.2) and heart rate variability (no data).

checkins.words: Check-in score: 1.6 of 4, the average of how far mood, energy and sleep were below their usual and anxiety above it (mood 2.0, anxiety 0.7, energy 2.0 and sleep (their rating) 1.8), at most 4. Shown beside the watch, not mixed into it.

sleep_min.label: Sleep length
sleep_min.rule: Shorter or longer than usual both count.
sleep_min.why: Short and poor sleep came before suicidal thoughts the next day in one study (Littlewood et al. 2019).
sleep_min.words: Sleep length, averaged over the 3 nights to Sun 1 Nov: 8 h 15. Usually 7 h 41, give or take 20 min, so 7 h 21 to 8 h 01, from 28 nights between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Their readings varied less than that, so RADR uses its smallest give-or-take for this measure. Now 34 min longer than usual: 1.7 times their usual give-or-take. It counts 1.7 of 4.

sleep_var.label: Sleep irregularity
sleep_var.rule: Only more irregular than usual counts.
sleep_var.why: Nights that varied in when someone fell asleep and woke came before more suicidal thoughts over three weeks, apart from depression (Bernert et al. 2017).
sleep_var.words: Sleep irregularity, how much the times they fell asleep and woke varied over the 7 nights to Sun 1 Nov: 84 min. Usually 61 min, give or take 12 min, so 49 to 73 min, from 28 nights between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Their readings varied less than that, so RADR uses its smallest give-or-take for this measure. Now 23 min more irregular than usual: 2.0 times their usual give-or-take. It counts 2.0 of 4.

midpoint.label: Middle of sleep
midpoint.rule: Earlier or later than usual both count.
midpoint.why: Day-to-day shifts in the body clock were the strongest sign before mood episodes in one study, with later sleep before depressive episodes (Lim et al. 2024).
midpoint.words: Middle of sleep, averaged over the 3 nights to Sun 1 Nov: 05:06. Usually 03:43, give or take 30 min, so 03:13 to 04:13, from 28 nights between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 1 h 23 later than usual: 2.7 times their usual give-or-take. It counts 2.7 of 4.

steps.label: Steps
steps.rule: Only fewer steps than usual count.
steps.why: Activity added to other measures in picking up depression, though on its own it says little (Rykov et al. 2021).
steps.words: Steps, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 3320 steps. Usually 8030 steps, give or take 1594 steps, so 6436 to 9625 steps, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 4711 steps fewer than usual: 3.0 times their usual give-or-take. It counts 3.0 of 4.

rhr.label: Resting heart rate
rhr.rule: Only a higher resting heart rate than usual counts.
rhr.why: Watch heart measures, read with mood ratings, carried signal in one study (Um et al. 2025).
rhr.words: Resting heart rate, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 66.3 bpm. Usually 61.6 bpm, give or take 1.5 bpm, so 60.1 to 63.1 bpm, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Their readings varied less than that, so RADR uses its smallest give-or-take for this measure. Now 4.8 bpm higher than usual: 3.2 times their usual give-or-take. It counts 3.2 of 4.

hrv.label: Heart rate variability
hrv.why: Heart rate variability was among the strongest watch measures in one study (Um et al. 2025).
hrv.words: Heart rate variability: too few readings in the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov (it needs 2). Not enough earlier data to know their usual yet: 0 of the 14 days needed, between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct.

mood.label: Mood
mood.rule: Only lower mood than usual counts.
mood.why: What they reported in their check-ins. Studies found asking does at least as well as watch data (Büscher et al. 2024).
mood.words: Mood in check-ins, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 2.0 of 5. Usually 3.5 of 5, give or take 0.7, so 2.8 to 4.2 of 5, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 1.5 lower than usual: 2.0 times their usual give-or-take. It adds 2.0 to the check-in score.

anxiety.label: Anxiety
anxiety.rule: Only more anxiety than usual counts.
anxiety.why: What they reported in their check-ins. Studies found asking does at least as well as watch data (Büscher et al. 2024).
anxiety.words: Anxiety in check-ins, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 2.3 of 5. Usually 2.0 of 5, give or take 0.5, so 1.5 to 2.5 of 5, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 0.3 higher than usual: 0.7 times their usual give-or-take. It adds 0.7 to the check-in score.

energy.label: Energy
energy.rule: Only lower energy than usual counts.
energy.why: What they reported in their check-ins. Studies found asking does at least as well as watch data (Büscher et al. 2024).
energy.words: Energy in check-ins, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 1.3 of 5. Usually 3.3 of 5, give or take 1.0, so 2.3 to 4.3 of 5, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 2.0 lower than usual: 2.0 times their usual give-or-take. It adds 2.0 to the check-in score.

sleepq.label: Sleep (their rating)
sleepq.rule: Only worse sleep than usual counts.
sleepq.why: What they reported in their check-ins. Studies found asking does at least as well as watch data (Büscher et al. 2024).
sleepq.words: Sleep (their rating) in check-ins, averaged over the 3 days to Sun 1 Nov: 2.3 of 5. Usually 3.4 of 5, give or take 0.6, so 2.8 to 4.0 of 5, from 28 days between Sun 27 Sep and Sat 24 Oct. Now 1.1 worse than usual: 1.8 times their usual give-or-take. It adds 1.8 to the check-in score.
